Praggnanandhaa Leads St. Louis Rapid Chess Tournament

Indian chess Grandmaster R. Praggnanandhaa finished first in the rapid phase of the St. Louis Rapid & Blitz tournament. He accumulated 12 points, securing a one-point lead over his competitors heading into the blitz portion of the event. This performance positions him favorably for qualification for the Grand Chess Tour Finals. The tournament is an annual event and a part of the professional chess circuit.
